council: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea
current_evidence: The council's 'Submitting a planning application' page (last updated 24 February 2026) links this document as the 'RBKC Local Validation List' (file 'RBKC Local Validation List 10 March 2023.pdf', 48 pages), the cover is dated 10 March 2023, and the page mentions no newer or draft list.

issues.detail: Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong: the link opens and returns the full 48-page 'Submission Requirements for Planning Applications' document, so the whole council was left unextracted (Req. items 0, every app type '(none)').
issues.evidence: Fetched OK: 'Submission Requirements for Planning Applications', Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 10 March 2023

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank. The document cover is dated 10 March 2023, so 'Outdated (>2y)?' should be Yes (over 3.5 years old at Nov 2026). It is still the council's current list.

None of the local requirements were captured. Section Two lists: Acoustic report (noise-generating development, plant incl. air conditioning and air source heat pumps, noisy changes of use); Affordable housing details (residential over 650 sqm GIA or any affordable housing); Air quality assessment (major and large-scale); Archaeological assessment (Archaeological Priority Areas); Biodiversity survey and report (affecting protected species/habitats, incl. refurbishments affecting bats or swifts); Community engagement strategy (all developments, proportionate); CIL liability form (100 sqm+ or 1+ dwellings); Construction method statement (new or enlarged basements); Construction traffic management plan (majors, basements, substantial demolition); Daylight/sunlight assessment (material impact on neighbouring light); Digital 3D model (significant townscape impacts); Energy strategy (majors); Fire statement (majors and Gateway One developments); Flood risk assessment (1ha+ in FZ1, all new development in FZ2/3, Critical Drainage Areas); Floorspace/accommodation schedule (new residential units or deconversions); Heritage statement (LBC, substantial demolition in CAs, works affecting listed buildings/CAs); Land contamination assessment; Lighting information; Marketing and use viability information (loss of community, hotel, office, pub, employment or shop uses); Parking and access arrangements; Photographs; Planning obligations/draft heads of terms; Planning statement; Planting and landscaping details; Servicing management plan; Site waste management plan (majors); Waste storage and collection details; SuDS strategy (all applications); Sustainability statement (majors); Tall buildings impact assessment; Town centre impact assessment (leisure/tourism over 2,500 sqm or retail over 400 sqm outside centres); Townscape and visual impact assessment (majors); Transport assessment (e.g. 30+ homes, commercial over 1,000 sqm); Travel plan (e.g. 80+ homes, commercial over 2,500 sqm, hotels 50+ beds); Tree survey/arboricultural implications; Ventilation/extraction details (cafes, restaurants, pubs, takeaways, commercial cooking).
issues.evidence: Section Two: Local requirements, with advice Notes 1-39 in Section Three

issues.detail: Application-type notes were also missed: Design and Access Statement is required for listed building consent and in conservation areas for 1+ dwellings or 100 sqm+, but not for s73 applications or pure changes of use; Heritage statement for LBC must include a schedule of works, justification, photographs and materials specification; householder site plans at 1:200; lighting details for illuminated advertisements; basements need construction method statement, CTMP, noise report and sections.
issues.evidence: Section One (Design and Access Statement) and Notes 3, 4, 6, 14, 22

issues.detail: 'Planning page' is a planning.data.gov.uk entity record, not the council's planning page, and the URL source is a third-party directory. The council page that links the list is rbkc.gov.uk/planning-and-building-control/planning-applications/making-planning-application/submitting-planning-application.
issues.evidence: Submitting a planning application page lists 'RBKC Local Validation List PDF, 366.3 KB, 48 pages'

summary: Grokbot's link is valid and is the current RBKC Local Validation List, dated 10 March 2023, but Grokbot wrongly marked it unreadable. It captured no requirements and no date, so all of the roughly 37 local requirements and the application-type notes are missing.
